property_summary: For any caller and any DAO address, if the caller is not the currently stored DAO and the contract has already been configured, calling setDAO must revert and leave DAO unchanged; the buggy version's removed guard allows overwriting DAO, so the post-call DAO getter differs from the pre-call value.
change_summary: Replace the setDAO guard with `require(true, "EK")`, allowing DAO to be overwritten in all cases.
